Dear Ben,

Thank you for your email and the group chat export. Please share this with Josh and Priya. We have raised the following:

1) Bathroom extractor fan not working (urgent)
Confirmed Time Slot: Monday 12 October, 14:00-16:00; Maintenance Provider Name: Bright Spark Electrical; Contact Details: +44 20 7946 0105. They will replace the fan.

2) Black mould on the bathroom ceiling and wall (urgent)
Confirmed Time Slot: Monday 12 October, 14:00-16:00; Maintenance Provider Name: DryHome Damp Specialists; Contact Details: +44 20 7946 0108. They will survey the mould and recommend treatment. Until then, please keep the bathroom window open during and after showers. Please don't scrub or bleach large patches yourselves. If your asthma gets worse, please speak to your GP and let us know.

3) Gutter dripping outside the window (routine)
Confirmed Time Slot: Friday 16 October, 09:00-11:00; Maintenance Provider Name: HandyPro; Contact Details: +44 20 7946 0107. This is outside work, but they may need to come through the gate or back garden. Please tell us or HandyPro if this time doesn't work, and which window it is.

4) Cracked induction hob - IMPORTANT SAFETY
Please stop using the whole hob, including the rings that still work. A crack in the glass can let liquid reach live parts and cause an electric shock. Please switch it off at the cooker isolator switch (or the hob breaker at the consumer unit) if you can do so safely. The electrician will check it on Monday and give us a quote. We will speak to the landlord before any repair is ordered.

Also: the chat mentions a "weird smell in the hall" several times. If it ever smells of gas or burning, open the windows, don't use light switches, leave the house and call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999. Then let us know.

If you have any pets, please tell the contractors. Please also tell the maintenance providers if anything changes on your end.

Kind regards,
Resolve - Maintenance team
